evidence.excerpt: We just launched @TareBioInc (@ycombinator S26)! 🚀 We make personalized or population-level vaccines for any cancer or infection in weeks. We've already cured cancer in mice and will vaccinate our first patient within the year. For over 200 years, vaccine design has followed these steps: study the insult → try to predict protective antigens. This works for simpler diseases, but has struggled for decades on more complex ones like HIV, TB, Hep C, and nearly every cancer. TareBio reverses this…
